messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT INC-2345 — hosted-api queue growth detected. queue_length=31874 p95=1.2s p99=6.3s. Autoscaler failing to create GPU nodes (quotaExceeded). Paging oncall: @pablo_oncall
jessica_sre: saw the spike at 10:02 UTC, identical client pattern; multiple tenants sending large batched requests. provisioner logs: `CreateInstance failed: quotaExceeded` repeated. backlog is growing and timeouts hitting customers.
pablo_oncall: ack taking it. First step: can we immediately divert non-critical traffic (free tier / low-priority) to a degraded path? I don't want to restart provisioner leader unless we have to.
ryan_platform: yes, can push a routing change to route tag=free -> model=quantized-small for 10m. Deploying now (routeset: overflow-quantized-v1).
monica_prod: good. Also suggest reducing server-side batch_size from 64->32 for critical models to reduce per-request latency while we recover. Will that increase token cost? yes but acceptable for emergency.
jessica_sre: autoscaler more concerning: leader is flapping, hitting API rate limits with cloud provider on instance creation. Trying to restart provisioner leader to clear stuck requests. Command: `kubectl -n infra rollout restart deploy/provisioner-leader`
cloud-eng: opened emergency quota request with cloud provider (ticket CLOUD-879). Requested +8 GPUs in region-us-west for 1 hour. ETA unknown. Also checking spare-pool allocations.
ryan_platform: route change live — ~2.1k rps moved to overflow. Monitoring p95/p99.
monica_prod: after route change p95 for critical routes down from 1.2s -> 420ms, p99 down from 6.3s -> 1.1s. backlog decreased ~22% in 3m. :thumbsup:
jessica_sre: provisioner leader restart in progress. Watch for eviction churn — if we see >5% eviction rate, pause.
pablo_oncall: handing off to @pablo_oncall (me) for next 30m. @sre-lead FYI taking ownership if this escalates.
sre-lead: oncall acknowledged. If quota is not granted in 10m, plan B: enable failfast for tier=free (return 429) + increase aggressive caching TTLs for embeddings to reduce load.
cloud-eng: provider responded: can grant +4 GPUs immediately if we agree to spot preemptible pool. Requesting approval.
pablo_oncall: approve +4 spot for 30m. Apply and monitor.
jessica_sre: spot pool added, autoscaler started creating 4 instances. Some instance creation logs show `InstanceReady` at +2m.
monica_prod: p95/p99 improving across the board. p99 now ~850ms. Backlog trending down.
ryan_platform: keeping the routing change for 15m and will gradually roll back once backlog <5000 and p99 < 500ms.
sre-lead: please capture root cause: why did autoscaler hit provider rate limits? Need postmortem checklist: quota preflight, provisioner leader stability, better overflow routing defaults.
pablo_oncall: noted. I'm adding a short status for customers: internal status page draft: "We experienced elevated latency and timeouts due to a transient capacity and autoscaler failure; mitigations in place and capacity added." Review? @monica_prod
monica_prod: fine to publish. Mention affected tenants were mostly free/beta.
incident-bot: UPDATE: oncall transferred to pablo_oncall at 10:12 UTC. Current severity: S2. Actions: routing change, batch-size reduction, added +4 spot GPUs. Next update in 15m or on major status change.
pablo_oncall: monitoring. If backlog stalls or we see repeat quotaExceeded patterns, we'll trigger SRE runbook and notify VP eng.
jessica_sre: logs show a burst of identical long-context requests from a single customer token at 09:59-10:03. Flagging for customer support to reach out post-incident.
monica_prod: started a short eval harness to replay 1000 requests on quantized-small to ensure behavior is acceptable before rollback.
sre-lead: thanks all. Prepare an initial incident report with timeline and customer impact window. I'm marking the incident as "mitigated" when backlog <3k and p99 stays <700ms for 10m.
pablo_oncall: will update thread. :shipit:
